summary: Your fifth teach-back. You write your guess for two kinds of question, explain when embeddings beat keywords and when they do not (with an example for each side), check six key points, and run both searches on the same questions to see embeddings win on a paraphrase and keywords win on an exact error code.
goal: Explain in 5 sentences when embeddings beat keywords and when they do not, with an example for each side.

items.text: Write which search you would trust for 'getting very warm' and for 'error E105', and why
Explain embeddings versus keywords with one example for each side in 5 sentences or a 60-second voice note
Tick the six key points your explanation said clearly and count them
Run both searches and see keywords find 0 words but embeddings find 'too hot', then see keywords win on E105
Write a better sentence for the biggest gap and add the missing example
Play the Search Showdown game to the end and see your score
